_about: Images supplied by the project owner (folder: C:/PAKISATAN WEB/remaining project pics), reviewed one by one on 4 Oct 2026.
Same fields as MASTER_IMAGE_MANIFEST.csv; merged by scripts/import-archive.mjs. `original` is the owner's file, copied (never modified) into assets-src/archive/ under `filename`.

Most are agency photographs at preview size (612 px wide, the Getty Images / AFP comp size). Their licence is the owner's to confirm: they are marked OWNER SUPPLIED, credited as not recorded, and should be swapped for the licensed full-resolution files before public release.
Captions say only what the picture itself shows. Where the date or place is not visible or recorded, it says so.

Rejected (not imported): 'mangla dam 2' (a mountain lake with pine forest — not Mangla), 'pakistan dam' (AFP 2025 infographic of Indian dams — not Mangla), 'US IRAN Peace talk' (a composite thumbnail; it shows President Raisi, who died in May 2024, so it cannot depict the 2026 talks), 'nuclear test 2' (a Shaheen missile on parade — not the Chagai tests), 'UN LOGO' (an emblem graphic, not a record).

Added at the owner's explicit request on 5 Oct 2026, with their caveats in the record: the two hockey photographs (first and second World Cup frames; matches not identified), the Zia tribute collage (quotation not verified) and the aircraft-wreckage photograph (not confirmed as the 1988 crash).
Held in the archive but kept out of the film (VERIFY): 'mangla dam' (spillway not identifiable as Mangla) and 'nuclear test mountain' (location not identifiable as Chagai).
Not yet placed, waiting for the owner: 'HOUSING PROGRAM' (a Punjab government event and a road-works publicity graphic) and 'PK TURK SAUDI DEFENSE' (no such section on the timeline).
